stories.title: Supreme Court sets principles for solid-waste compensation
stories.summary: The Supreme Court has asked the Union Environment Ministry to frame guidelines for environmental compensation under the Solid Waste Management Rules, 2026, Bar & Bench reports. The Court laid down eight principles, including that compensation is restitutionary, comes in addition to fines, and continues until the damage is reversed. The direction arose in a case involving Amravati Municipal Corporation.

stories.title: Landslides repeatedly disrupt Mizoram–Myanmar trade corridor
stories.summary: Recurring monsoon landslides are disrupting the final road stretch of the Kaladan Multi-Modal Transit Transport Project between Mizoram and Myanmar, EastMojo reports. stories.title: Supreme Court acquits man after 22 years in prison
